contracts_rationale: No interface changes: a domain refactor, a validate-mode fix and a CI wiring change; the OpenAPI contract is untouched.
purpose_context: Epic #186 reads all Charter Pack content into the domain and writes it back. The operator ruled on 2026-11-05 that the epic closes once two known gaps are fixed (#299: mission step Markdown is only checked at write; #319: a pack root path with '..' makes validate mode wrongly refuse mission types) and the whole-pack round-trip check becomes part of the one required CI check, with the docs updated to match.
purpose_tldr: Close the whole-pack round-trip epic: mission step texts are checked when built, a pack root with '..' validates, and every PR must keep packs round-tripping.
